personas.name: The treadmill coach
personas.who: Fitness and online coaches who get every client from ads or from posting every day.
pains: Every client costs about $200 in ads, and the price keeps rising
One week off and the leads disappear
Leads scattered across DMs, email, WhatsApp and booking apps
desires: Clients that keep coming while they rest
Stop being the only source of every sale
objections: I don't have time to run a community
I tried a group before and it died
phrases: If I miss a day, I feel it
Can I finally take off the ring light?

personas.name: The creator with followers but no sales
personas.who: Creators and course sellers with an audience that watches but doesn't buy.
pains: Thousands of followers, a handful of sales
Each post reaches a small share of followers
Shouting 'buy now' in stories feels tiring and doesn't sell
desires: Followers who see each other buy and win
A launch that doesn't depend on the algorithm
objections: Communities are only for big creators
phrases: Why do I sell so little with so many followers?

personas.name: The ads-dependent service business
personas.who: Studios, clinics and service owners who pay for every new client.
desires: An owned channel that keeps working when ads stop
objections: My business isn't a 'community' type of business
